explore-angle.title: Shorten the skip
explore-angle.prompt: On 14 MHz at midday, raise the radiation angle until the signal comes down within 1500 km.
explore-angle.success: Higher angle, shorter skip: geometry, with the region height unchanged.

explore-europe.title: Two hops to Europe
explore-europe.prompt: Lower the radiation angle until two hops reach Europe.
hints: Below about 6° each F2 hop is long enough.
explore-europe.success: Low angles give the longest hops: two take you about 5000 km.
